frontmatter.title: Null-constrained block bootstrap for independent series

references.title: D. Pilavakis, E. Paparoditis, and T. Sapatinas, Moving block and tapered block bootstrap for functional time series with an application to the K-sample mean problem, Bernoulli 25 (2019), Section 3.2

manifest_row_without_root_owned_dependen.title: Null-constrained block bootstrap for independent series
manifest_row_without_root_owned_dependen.statement:
**Input:** a fixed number $K\ge2$ of observed series $Y_{i,1},\ldots,Y_{i,n_i}$ in a real Hilbert space $H$, positive integer sample sizes $n_i$, total size $M=\sum_{i=1}^K n_i$, integer block lengths $1\le b_i\le n_i$, and a mode, moving or tapered. For tapered mode also supply an admissible window with positive block norm at each $b_i$. Put

$$\bar Y_i=\frac1{n_i}\sum_{t=1}^{n_i}Y_{i,t},\qquad \bar Y_P=\frac1M\sum_{i=1}^K n_i\bar Y_i,\qquad R_{i,t}=Y_{i,t}-\bar Y_i.$$

For each series $i=1,\ldots,K$, let $N_i=n_i-b_i+1$ and $k_i=\lceil n_i/b_i\rceil$. For every candidate start $j=1,\ldots,N_i$ and position $r=1,\ldots,b_i$, define the following arrays. In moving mode set $A_{i,j,r}=R_{i,j+r-1}$. In tapered mode set $A_{i,j,r}=a_{b_i}w_{b_i}(r)R_{i,j+r-1}$, with $a_{b_i}$ and $w_{b_i}$ as in [[alg-tapered-block-bootstrap]]. For each $i=1,\ldots,K$ and $s=1,\ldots,k_i$, draw independent uniform starts $J_{i,s}\in\{1,\ldots,N_i\}$, using the index law of [[alg-overlapping-block-resampling]]. For each within-block position define

$$c_{i,r}=\frac1{N_i}\sum_{j=1}^{N_i}A_{i,j,r}.$$

**Output:** for each $i$, a pseudo-series $Y^*_{i,1},\ldots,Y^*_{i,n_i}$. In the order $s=1,\ldots,k_i$, retain the positions $r=1,\ldots,q_{i,s}$, where $q_{i,s}=\min\{b_i,n_i-(s-1)b_i\}$, and set

$$Y^*_{i,(s-1)b_i+r}=\bar Y_P+A_{i,J_{i,s},r}-c_{i,r}.$$

Thus a divisible sample uses $k_i$ complete blocks; otherwise only the first $n_i-b_i\lfloor n_i/b_i\rfloor$ positions of the final block are retained. This centers each resampled residual position by its own conditional average, then gives every pseudo-series the same pooled location $\bar Y_P$. All block starts are conditionally independent across blocks and across series.
manifest_row_without_root_owned_dependen.strategy: Operational definition; no phase proof is applicable.

frontmatter.title: Exact null centering of the K-sample block bootstrap

references.title: D. Pilavakis, E. Paparoditis, and T. Sapatinas, Moving block and tapered block bootstrap for functional time series with an application to the K-sample mean problem, Bernoulli 25 (2019), Section 3.2

manifest_row_without_root_owned_dependen.title: Exact null centering of the K-sample block bootstrap
manifest_row_without_root_owned_dependen.statement:
For fixed data and either mode of [[alg-k-sample-null-constrained-block-bootstrap]], every pseudo-observation in every series has conditional expectation $\bar Y_P$. Consequently, for each $i$,

$$E^*\bar Y_i^*=\bar Y_P,$$

so the conditional mean functions of the $K$ pseudo-series are equal.

frontmatter.proof_strategy: block decomposition, conditional iid limit, covariance consistency and Hilbert-space tightness

manifest_row_without_root_owned_dependen.title: Moving block bootstrap CLT for dependent Hilbert-valued data
manifest_row_without_root_owned_dependen.statement:
Assume the Axiom of Choice. Let $H=L^2([0,1])$, and let $(X_t)_{t\in\mathbb Z}$ be a centered causal Bernoulli shift that is $L^2$-$m$-approximable under [[def-l2-m-approximable-causal-bernoulli-shift]]. Write

$$\delta_m=\bigl(E\|X_0-X_{0,m}\|_H^2\bigr)^{1/2}.$$

Assume the stronger approximation condition $m\delta_m\to0$. For each $n$, let $b_n$ be an integer with $b_n\to\infty$ and $b_n/\sqrt n\to0$. For all sufficiently large $n$, these conditions give $1\le b_n\le n$; apply [[alg-moving-block-bootstrap]] to $X_1,\ldots,X_n$ on this admissible tail. All limits below concern that tail. Let $\Gamma$ be the long-run covariance operator from [[thm-hilbert-valued-clt-for-l2-m-approximable-bernoulli-shifts]], and let $\bar X_n^*=n^{-1}\sum_{t=1}^nX_t^*$. Then

$$\mathcal L^*\!\left(\sqrt n(\bar X_n^*-E^*\bar X_n^*)\right)\Rightarrow\mathcal L(G)\quad\hbox{in probability},$$

and

$$\left\|n\,\operatorname{Cov}^*(\bar X_n^*)-\Gamma\right\|_{\mathrm{HS}}\longrightarrow0\quad\hbox{in probability},$$

where $G$ is the centered $H$-valued Gaussian with covariance $\Gamma$.

manifest_row_without_root_owned_dependen.title: Tapered block bootstrap CLT for dependent Hilbert-valued data
manifest_row_without_root_owned_dependen.statement:
Assume the Axiom of Choice. Let $H=L^2([0,1])$, and let $(Y_t)_{t\in\mathbb Z}$ be a centered causal Bernoulli shift that is $L^2$-$m$-approximable under [[def-l2-m-approximable-causal-bernoulli-shift]]. Write

$$\delta_m=\bigl(E\|Y_0-Y_{0,m}\|_H^2\bigr)^{1/2}.$$

Assume $m\delta_m\to0$, and let the integers $b_n\to\infty$ with $b_n/\sqrt n\to0$. Let the taper satisfy the support, positivity-near-$1/2$, symmetry and monotonicity conditions in [[alg-tapered-block-bootstrap]]. For all sufficiently large $n$, $1\le b_n\le n$ and $W_{b_n}>0$, the latter by [[lem-taper-window-l2-normalization]]. Apply that algorithm to $Y_1,\ldots,Y_n$ only on this admissible tail; all limits below concern that tail. Write $\bar Y_n^*=n^{-1}\sum_{t=1}^nY_t^*$ for the resulting bootstrap mean. Let $\Gamma$ be the long-run covariance operator from [[thm-hilbert-valued-clt-for-l2-m-approximable-bernoulli-shifts]]. Then

$$\mathcal L^*\!\left(\sqrt n(\bar Y_n^*-E^*\bar Y_n^*)\right)\Rightarrow\mathcal L(G)\quad\hbox{in probability},$$

and

$$\left\|n\,\operatorname{Cov}^*(\bar Y_n^*)-\Gamma\right\|_{\mathrm{HS}}\longrightarrow0\quad\hbox{in probability},$$

where $G$ is centered Gaussian with covariance $\Gamma$.

frontmatter.title: Two-series null centering with a final block prefix

manifest_row_without_root_owned_dependen.title: Two-series null centering with a final block prefix
manifest_row_without_root_owned_dependen.statement: Apply moving-mode [[alg-k-sample-null-constrained-block-bootstrap]] in $H=\mathbb R$ to the series $(0,2,4)$ and $(10,12,14,16)$, with $b_1=b_2=2$. Their observed means are $2$ and $13$, but both bootstrap series have conditional mean $\bar Y_P=58/7$.

frontmatter.title: IID functional data in the block bootstrap regime

manifest_row_without_root_owned_dependen.title: IID functional data in the block bootstrap regime
manifest_row_without_root_owned_dependen.statement: Assume the Axiom of Choice. In $H=L^2([0,1])$, let $e$ be the constant function $1$ and let $X_t=\varepsilon_t e$, where the innovations $\varepsilon_t$ are independent with $P(\varepsilon_t=1)=P(\varepsilon_t=-1)=1/2$. This IID functional series satisfies the moving and tapered block bootstrap theorems with $b_n=\lceil n^{1/3}\rceil$ and, in tapered mode, the window $w(u)=\mathbf1_{[0,1]}(u)$.
